A machine configuration with theme repositories, for `theme-repos` in eval.nix:
`themes.json` beside `apps.json` and the copies of the checked themes in `themes/`.
Lucifer is used; the second repository names a god (`saturnus`), a theme whose
folder is missing (`ghost`) and no id at all (`../etc`). All three are left out
with a warning. The wallpaper is a plain 2560 by 1440 JPEG, not the real plate.
